howto.what: Claude 可以帮你创建、配置和管理 AWS Lambda 函数，包括设置触发器、调试调用、优化冷启动、管理事件源映射和层。
howto.when: 当你需要处理 AWS Lambda 相关任务时，例如创建函数、配置触发器、调试调用、优化冷启动、设置事件源映射或管理层。

say.text: 给 MyFunction 添加一个 S3 触发器，桶名为 my-bucket。
say.note: Claude 会提供添加权限和配置 S3 通知的步骤。

say.text: 如何优化 Lambda 函数的冷启动？
say.note: Claude 会列出减少冷启动的方法，如使用预置并发。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you create, configure, and manage AWS Lambda functions, including setting up triggers, debugging invocations, optimizing cold starts, managing event source mappings, and layers.
howto.when_en: When you need to work with AWS Lambda tasks such as creating functions, configuring triggers, debugging invocations, optimizing cold starts, setting up event source mappings, or managing layers.

say_en.text: Create a Python 3.12 Lambda function with 256 MB memory.
say_en.note: Claude will generate CLI or boto3 code to create the function.

say_en.text: Add an S3 trigger to MyFunction for bucket my-bucket.
say_en.note: Claude will provide steps to add permission and configure S3 notification.

say_en.text: How to reduce cold start latency for Lambda?
say_en.note: Claude will list methods like using Provisioned Concurrency.
